d: Company Description Turbo Pay is a next-generation electronic payment, tipping, and donations platform that simplifies cashless transactions for businesses, employees, customers, and charities. The company enables instant tipping, donations, and payments via QR codes or NFC-enabled devices, with secure processing through certified acquiring partners and fast settlements to recipients. Turbo Pay offers smart tipping and donations, seamless fund transfers, and custom-branded NFC readers, QR stands, and marketing materials tailored to each organization. Built on scalable, bank-grade infrastructure compatible with leading processors, the platform helps clients boost engagement, improve customer and donor experiences, and eliminate cash-handling friction. Guided by the belief that every tap counts, Turbo Pay supports businesses and communities in creating more rewarding everyday transactions.

Role Description The Outside Sales Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in the Kuwait City Metropolitan Area. This position is responsible for identifying and prospecting new business opportunities, conducting in-person meetings and product demonstrations, and presenting Turbo Pay’s solutions to merchants, service providers, and charitable organizations. Day-to-day activities include managing a sales pipeline, negotiating commercial terms, preparing proposals, and closing deals while maintaining strong, long-term client relationships. The specialist will collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and implementation, provide ongoing support and training to clients, and gather market feedback to inform product and sales strategies. The role requires regular field visits, networking, and participation in local events to grow brand awareness and accelerate adoption of Turbo Pay’s platform.
q: Demonstrated experience in Sales and Outside/Field Sales, including prospecting, pipeline management, and closing new business.
Strong Customer Service and Account Management skills to build trust, manage client expectations, and support long-term relationships.
Experience in Field Service and on-site client support, including handling technical or operational inquiries in collaboration with internal teams.
Ability to deliver Training and product demonstrations to merchants, employees, and partners in a clear, persuasive manner.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders in English; Arabic language proficiency is an advantage.
Proven ability to work independently in the field, organize schedules, and meet or exceed sales targets.
Background in fintech, payments, POS solutions, or related technology sectors is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent
